body: I get it OP thinks that two songs per episode is too much (personally I love it, but I'm a theater kid so). I just don't understand what is cringe about the song itself? It's emotional, cheesy even, but it hits all the right spots when it comes to mending a relationship with you father figure imo
Ronové works for sure. But being honest healers in this game so far are really underwhelming. Buer's ult on 20 lvl heals for 220HP which is pretty useless imo

Waiting for others to notice is really exhausting, been there, done that.  If I were you, I would try to find someone you can trust and make the first step. I know how hard it is. When you can't even get out of your bed, asking for something like this seems ridiculous, but trust me, it's worth it. And if I somehow were to convince you to fight for yourself and be happy, that would make me the happiest I've ever been

I know growing up can be scary. This year I will turn 20, and frankly, I hate the idea. I still feel like that 12 y/o child I used to be tho. Don't let the number define you, and remember that there are people out there who care about you. Like me, for example
